phrases.latin: Pater in tablīnum iit, jānuam clausit, computātrulum in mēnsā scrīptōriā aperuit
phrases.english: Dad went into the study, shut the door and opened his laptop on the desk
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 261, 337.
Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
